messages.text: Hello! I'm MercuriusDream, a Computer Science student at Chungbuk National University.
I mainly delve into low-level systems with C (C99/C11) and modern C++, but I also use Python for scripting and rapid prototyping.
My work often involves black-box reverse engineering, network packet analysis, and secure API engineering.
I'm deeply interested in Large Language Models (LLM), particularly prompt engineering and red-teaming to find vulnerabilities.
I also enjoy writing technical documentation to share what I learn.
What projects have you worked on?
Check out my pinned repositories! C99-6502 is a cycle-accurate NES/Apple II CPU emulator.
And Canaria is a real-time earthquake early warning system aggregating data from KMA, JMA, and others.
Also, try blaming on your CDN with CloudFront Error Generator!
